findings: LIVE filled 502 maker orders: 169 with a print through their price, 317 with prints only AT it from the other side, 16 with neither (results/fill_model.json); the twins' rule 1 predicts 169 of them, the at-price rule 486.

Fixed simulation (at_ops) against LIVE: orders 84.7 % / 86.2 % matched (base 76.4 % / 85.4 %); fills 51.1 % of LIVE's (20.3 %); on orders both placed, 92.1 % of the filled agree (67.8 %); round trips 204 v 218 (130); realised GBP 0.972 v 0.880 (0.245).

Placement timing on the LIVE-faithful replay: turning 0 s or 10 s into the minute instead of LIVE's 30 s loses GBP 0.245 and 0.196 (day bootstrap 90 % bands -0.403..-0.083 and -0.326..-0.079): earlier is worse (results/timing.json).
